## s12-v14 — argument map

Facing everywhere (sakalataḥ) in agitation (vibhramamāṇāḥ) — things coming and going (gatāgatā), may they shine (bhāntu) for me (me). Facing everywhere in agitation: may things shine.

### Open
- Whether 'vibhramamāṇāḥ' means 'agitated' or 'bewildered' is unresolved.
- Whether 'gatāgatā' refers to things or to the devotee is unresolved.
